resources.string: Opens Nocturne’s releases on GitHub in your browser, newest at the top. If its version is newer than the one installed, download the APK there and open it to update. Nocturne itself never goes online.
Nocturne controls BedJet 3 nights over Bluetooth.
BedJet protocol work by the Lull project (github.com/rkanjani/lull, MIT)
